framework.name: HIPAA Security Rule
framework.description: HIPAA Security Rule standards and implementation specifications for electronic protected health information (ePHI). Matches the Appendix A to Subpart C matrix for 164.308-164.312 (18 standards; 36 implementation specifications = 14 Required + 22 Addressable), plus 164.314 and 164.316. Public domain; citations to 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C. Descriptions summarised in our own words. 'kind' is 'standard' or 'spec'.
framework.sourceDocument: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C and Appendix A to Subpart C (Security Standards: Matrix)

controls.title: Security Management Process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations affecting ePHI.

controls.title: Risk Analysis
controls.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.description: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.

controls.title: Sanction Policy
controls.description: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with security policies and procedures.

controls.title: Information System Activity Review
controls.description: Regularly review records of information system activity such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.description: Identify the security official responsible for developing and implementing the required security policies and procedures.

controls.title: Workforce Security
controls.description: Ensure appropriate workforce access to ePHI and prevent those who should not have access from obtaining it.

controls.title: Authorization and/or Supervision
controls.description: Authorize and/or supervise workforce members who work with ePHI or in locations where it might be accessed.

controls.title: Workforce Clearance Procedure
controls.description: Determine that a workforce member's access to ePHI is appropriate.

controls.title: Termination Procedures
controls.description: Terminate access to ePHI when a workforce member's employment or access authorization ends.

controls.title: Information Access Management
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI consistent with the minimum necessary principle.

controls.title: Isolating Health Care Clearinghouse Functions
controls.description: If part of a larger organization, protect clearinghouse ePHI from unauthorized access by the larger organization.

controls.title: Access Authorization
controls.description: Grant access to ePHI through a workstation, transaction, program, or process.

controls.title: Access Establishment and Modification
controls.description: Establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to ePHI.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all workforce members, including management.

controls.title: Security Reminders
controls.description: Provide periodic security updates and reminders to the workforce.

controls.title: Protection from Malicious Software
controls.description: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.

controls.title: Log-in Monitoring
controls.description: Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.

controls.title: Password Management
controls.description: Procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.

controls.title: Response and Reporting
controls.description: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate harmful effects and document incidents and outcomes.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
aiRiskDomains: AI System Safety, Failures, and Limitations
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems containing ePHI.

controls.title: Data Backup Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.

controls.title: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to restore any loss of ePHI.

controls.title: Emergency Mode Operation Plan
controls.description: Establish procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes to protect ePHI while operating in emergency mode.

controls.title: Testing and Revision Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.

controls.title: Applications and Data Criticality Analysis
controls.description: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of contingency plan components.

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.description: Perform periodic technical and non-technical evaluations of how well security policies and procedures meet the Security Rule.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts and Other Arrangements
controls.description: Obtain satisfactory assurances that business associates will appropriately safeguard ePHI they create, receive, maintain, or transmit.

controls.title: Written Contract or Other Arrangement
controls.description: Document the satisfactory assurances required from a business associate through a written contract or other arrangement meeting the applicable requirements.

controls.title: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Limit physical access to electronic information systems and the facilities that house them, while ensuring authorized access.

controls.title: Contingency Operations
controls.description: Establish procedures to allow facility access to support restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery and emergency mode operation plans.

controls.title: Facility Security Plan
controls.description: Safeguard the facility and equipment from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.

controls.title: Access Control and Validation Procedures
controls.description: Control and validate a person's access to facilities based on role or function, including visitor control.

controls.title: Maintenance Records
controls.description: Document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility related to security.

controls.title: Workstation Use
controls.description: Specify the proper functions and physical attributes of the surroundings of workstations that access ePHI.

controls.title: Workstation Security
controls.description: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access ePHI to restrict access to authorized users.

controls.title: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain ePHI into and out of a facility.

controls.title: Disposal
controls.description: Address the final disposition of ePHI and the hardware or media on which it is stored.

controls.title: Media Re-use
controls.description: Remove ePHI from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and the person responsible.

controls.title: Data Backup and Storage
controls.description: Create a retrievable, exact copy of ePHI, when needed, before movement of equipment.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures that allow only authorized persons or software to access ePHI.

controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.description: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

controls.title: Emergency Access Procedure
controls.description: Establish procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency.

controls.title: Automatic Logoff
controls.description: Terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

controls.title: Encryption and Decryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI at rest.

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems that contain or use ePHI.

controls.title: Integrity
aiRiskDomains: AI System Safety, Failures, and Limitations
controls.description: Protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.title: Mechanism to Authenticate ePHI
controls.description: Implement electronic mechanisms to confirm that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.description: Guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over an electronic communications network.

controls.title: Integrity Controls (Transmission)
controls.description: Ensure that electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.

controls.title: Encryption (Transmission)
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate during transmission.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts or Other Arrangements
controls.description: Document, through a written contract or other arrangement, that a business associate will safeguard ePHI per the Security Rule.

controls.title: Business Associate Contract Requirements
controls.description: The business associate contract must require the business associate to comply with the applicable Security Rule requirements.

controls.title: Business Associate Subcontractors
controls.description: Require business associates to ensure subcontractors that handle ePHI agree to comparable safeguards.

controls.title: Policies and Procedures
controls.description: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the Security Rule standards and specifications.

controls.title: Documentation
controls.description: Maintain the required policies, procedures, actions, activities, and assessments in written (which may be electronic) form.

controls.title: Documentation — Time Limit
controls.description: Retain documentation for 6 years from the date of its creation or when it was last in effect, whichever is later.

controls.title: Documentation — Availability
controls.description: Make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which it pertains.

controls.title: Documentation — Updates
controls.description: Review documentation periodically and update it in response to environmental or operational changes affecting ePHI security.
